_comment: Saltmarsh Exchange: the IIS + FTP web-tier WINDOWS hardening box (workgroup member server swa-web01; os contains 'win' so nakon uses its PowerShell deploy path -- SSH transport, Windows OpenSSH, run.ps1 with per-step scripts; elevation comes from the SSH principal, which must be a local administrator). ORDER MATTERS: iis-ftp-base-win installs the IIS/FTP roles and builds the business-functional baseline (site SaltmarshPortal on portal.saltmarsh.local, app pool, /backoffice app, FTP site VendorDrop, local group SaltmarshVendors + account ftp_vendor, ACLs, FTPS cert, logging, scoped SaltmarshFtpIn rule) BEFORE any of the -off seeds flip it. The account plants run before the group-add and before the file plants; the live web.config / web.config.bak / diag.aspx / .git / credential file and the portal-source.zip follow the base. ftp-hardening-off-win runs LAST so its broad Any-scope firewall rule and anonymous authorization are the final state. iis-hardening-off-win, iis-backoffice-open-win and iis-admin-console-win each depend_on iis-ftp-base-win, so selecting one alone still resolves the base first. Name discipline: every SITE / APP POOL / FTP SITE / GROUP / USER / RULE_NAME / FILE_PATH here MUST match its paired check's collect params in scenario.yaml byte-for-byte -- nothing cross-validates them. Disable-don't-delete: svc_webdeploy is planted as a local admin and the paired check wants it DISABLED (not deleted); local-user-enable-win exists because local-user-win's update path never flips Enabled, so a re-plant after a team disables the account restores the 0-state. ftp_vendor is a LEGITIMATE business account -- base re-enables and re-passwords it on every plant; the finding is only its Administrators membership. Forensics breadcrumbs: fq_webdeploy_account (the account), fq_ftp_vendor_password (the outgoing credential file), fq_db_password (the web.config.bak connection string), fq_apppool_identity (the LocalSystem pool), fq_webshell_name (diag.aspx), fq_admin_port (the SaltmarshAdmin site on 8080). The base is the SECURE baseline for the flip-based findings; the absence-based findings (no HTTPS binding, no redirect) are simply absent at baseline. Re-running plant restores the 0-state; re-plant after a harden pass is the revert procedure. Template prep: full clone windows-server-fix (953), local admin sysadmin/SaltmarshBuild2026!, OpenSSH + password auth, Python 3.12 at C:\Python312 on PATH, RDP+NLA, firewall rules for 22. IIS/FTP can be pre-installed in the template to shorten the first plant (the base seed is idempotent).
